verdict.rationale: Adyen Agentic serves merchants and agent platforms. Its documented credential model tokenizes a shopper's existing payment credential into checkout-scoped ACP/UCP tokens that the agent passes to merchants. Nothing in the evidence describes a user-funded wallet that an agent holds and spends from, user-set spending controls, or balance visibility. Payment credentials for agents are a fair axis for an agentic-payments product, so the absence of this capability is 'none' rather than 'na'.
